parityScope.targetEquivalenceStatement: For the scoped Lean 4.33.1 kernel fragment, Lean accepts/checks/reduces an artifact iff PSKernel accepts/checks/reduces its translation, with matching typing, environment-extension, and rejection boundaries.

rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Level translation preserves well-formedness, comparison, max/imax normalization, and universe constraint behavior.
rows.nextProofWork: Define TrLevel and prove level normalization/comparison soundness+completeness.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Sort, const, app, lam, forallE, letE, lit, mdata, proj, bvar/fvar/mvar boundary
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: TrExpr preserves expression well-formedness, binding depth, local context references, and closedness.
rows.nextProofWork: Formalize Expr translation relation and closedness lemmas.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Local declarations, dependency ordering, binder info relevance boundary
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: TrLCtx preserves variable lookup, dependency ordering, and declaration well-formedness.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Kernel admission of declarations into an environment
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Lean addDecl accepts iff PS addDecl accepts translated declarations.
rows.nextProofWork: Define declaration acceptance relation and rejection classes.

rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Declaration-kind translation preserves typing, value optionality, opacity, reducibility, and safety metadata.
rows.nextProofWork: Audit PSKernel declaration metadata versus Lean declaration fields.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Mutual definitions and termination/compiled payload boundary
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Translated mutual blocks preserve type checking and do not accept extra recursive definitions.
rows.nextProofWork: Separate kernel checking from elaborator termination evidence.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Inductive declarations, constructors, recursor metadata, computation rules
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Inductive/constructor/recursor translation preserves typing, parameter/index arity, major premises, motives, and iota behavior.
rows.nextProofWork: Use KA45+ arena corpus to seed theorem obligations.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Constructor application, structure projections, projection reduction
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Projection and constructor reductions match Lean for translated structures/inductives.
rows.nextProofWork: Connect structure runtime tests to kernel recursor/projection model.

rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Lean WHNF corresponds to PS WHNF for translated terms and environments.
rows.nextProofWork: Formalize trace certificate relation for WHNF.

rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Lean DefEq iff PS DefEq for translated expressions under matched transparency.
Sort and inductive universe constraints are accepted/rejected equivalently.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Quot, Quot.mk/lift/sound and quotient reduction boundary
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Quotient typing and kernel reduction behavior match Lean exactly.
rows.nextProofWork: Isolate quotient primitives and prove/compare reduction rules.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Kernel proof irrelevance in Prop and proof-bearing terms
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Proof irrelevance rules neither under- nor over-accept translated terms.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Reducibility hints and transparency modes for unfolding
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Transparency setting drives identical unfolding decisions for translated constants.
rows.nextProofWork: Map Lean transparency modes to PSKernel options.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Linear declaration addition and environment lookup effects
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Environment extension and lookup commute with translation.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Axioms, unsafe, trusted declarations, and kernel trust levels
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: PSKernel does not silently treat trusted/unsafe artifacts as proven equivalence.
rows.nextProofWork: Audit trust levels and metadata claims.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Reject invalid terms/declarations with matched rejection class
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: If Lean rejects a kernel artifact, PSKernel rejects the translation class-equivalently.
rows.nextProofWork: Build negative conformance corpus and classify errors.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Proof erasure versus executable artifacts and runtime emitters
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Executable dashboard claims do not leak into full kernel theorem claims.
rows.nextProofWork: Keep proof/runtime boundary explicit in release gates.

rows.lean4331KernelScope: Lean kernel objects ↔ PSKernel core/cert/proof-carrying artifacts
rows.requiredEquivalenceObligation: Translation relation is total on scoped Lean objects and injective enough for completeness.
rows.nextProofWork: Start KA-130 translation skeleton after conformance corpus.

gapReport.reason: KA-127 closed the executable-equivalence dashboard, but no soundness+completeness theorem against the Lean 4.33.1 kernel has been proven.
